metadata.case_name: FUNG YIU v. CHEUNG SIU PING

plaintiff.occupation_before: Supervisor and watchman in a garment factory; previously conductor with the KMB Co.
plaintiff.occupation_after: Unable to hold down a job / unable to work

injuries.description: Post-Traumatic Dementia (being a mental impairment with fatuity. apathy and memory defect) which was moderate in degree.
source: Post-Traumatic Dementia (being a mental impairment with fatuity. apathy and memory defect) which was moderate in degree.

injuries.description: Post-Traumatic Epilepsy also moderate in degree.
source: Post-Traumatic Epilepsy also moderate in degree.
injuries.icd_description: Epilepsy due to injuries to the head

injuries.description: Partial paralysis of the right arm and right leg with 50% loss of power in the right arm and limitation of movement at the right ankle joint.
source: Partial paralysis of the right arm and right leg with 50% loss of power in the right arm and limitation of movement at the right ankle joint.

injuries.description: Post-Concussicnal syndrome (a mental impairment with giddiness and headache) which was moderate in degree.
source: Post-Concussicnal syndrome (a mental impairment with giddiness and headache) which was moderate in degree.

injuries.description: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (consisting of an abnormal fear of motor vehicles) moderate in degree.
source: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (consisting of an abnormal fear of motor vehicles) moderate in degree.

injuries.description: Shortening of the right leg by 1 cm.
source: Shortening of the right leg by 1 cm.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: 50% loss of power in the right arm
limitation of movement at the right ankle joint
shortening of the right leg by 1 cm
cannot walk properly because of his crippled right leg
cannot cook food, take a bath or walk in a crowded street without his wife's assistance
unable to concentrate when reading the newspaper or watching T.V.; unable to make calculations; often feels drowsy in the daytime and sleeps for an hour or so at a time
required to take 3 different types of medication in form of pills to control his condition

treatments_received: Hospitalisation (6-7 months in hospital stated in evidence)

losses.description: Poor memory, inability to concentrate, inability to make calculations, memory defect as described in evidence.
Cannot walk properly because of crippled right leg; limitation of movement at the right ankle joint; shortening of the right leg by 1 cm.
Unable to cook, take a bath or walk in a crowded street without wife's assistance.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to perform household tasks such as cooking; needs assistance for bathing and shopping.
Plaintiff admits that since the accident he is bad-tempered and becomes annoyed easily.
Plaintiff was unable to resume his former position and would not now be able to hold down a job.
Plaintiff's life expectancy shortened by 4 years (award made on basis that normal life expectancy of 60 year old male is 16 years and shortened by 4 years).
